rows.title: feat(app): fold tall file diffs in the timeline
rows.summary: A file's diff in an edit/patch row shows 420 px, fading out under a 32 px 'Show more' / 'Show less' toggle (chevron turns); closing keeps the toggle where it was pressed.
rows.status_evidence: PR #642: crates/session-view/src/tools/files.rs fold(): a file change taller than 420 px (rows x 24, unwrapped) shows 396 px fading out over 48 px under a 32 px Show more / Show less toggle (ui.common.showMore/showLess, 13 px medium, muted, chevron turns), lying over the last 8 px; closing holds the toggle. Height is estimated from rows, so wrapped lines fold later than official (which measures).

rows.title: feat(app): archive the open session with Ctrl+Shift+S
rows.summary: A session command "Archive session" (mod+shift+s), for root sessions not yet archived: archives on the server, refreshes Home/inbox lists and removes the tab (the view moves to the next open session); a failure toasts.
rows.status_evidence: rune-desktop #740 (a4bdc387a4): session.archive (Mod+Shift+S, Settings > Shortcuts row) archives the open root session not yet archived through the session menu's archive_session: lists update, its tab closes, Undo toast kept.
rows.risks: mod+shift+s must not collide with an existing binding.

rows.title: fix(desktop): remember the first window as focused when it opens focused
rows.summary: The first window is created and shown focused before it is registered, so its focus event had already passed: register() now records it as the last-focused window when win.isFocused().
rows.status_evidence: apps/desktop/src/workspace/windows/mod.rs register() calls focused(id) right after pushing the window into OPEN, so the first window is the most recently focused from the start; on_focus (windows/open.rs) stamps it again on every later focus. Difference: ours stamps every registered window, also one restored in the background, where official stamps only a window that is focused at registration; the next real focus event corrects the order.
